"""An end-to-end showcase: nested types, pipes, machine, deduplication."""
import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

types = [
  {"name": "U16", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
  {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"},
  {"name": "Name", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8},
  {"name": "Kind", "kind": "enum", "values": ["read", "write"]},
  {"name": "Op", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["kind", "Kind"], ["count", "U16"]]},
  {"name": "Ops", "kind": "array", "element": "Op", "size": 2},
  {"name": "Request", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["ops", "Ops"], ["user", "Name"]]},
  {"name": "Handle", "kind": "alias", "target": "Request"},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["idle", "busy", "done"]},
]
modules = [
  {"name": "serve", "params": [["req", "Handle"], ["state", "State"], ["msg", "Name"]],
   "result": ["out", "Flag"],
   "requires": ["all", "op", ["field", ["var", "req"], "ops"],
                ["lt", ["field", ["var", "op"], "count"], ["const", "U16", 1000]]]},
  {"name": "valid_user", "params": [["u", "Name"]], "result": ["ok", "Flag"],
   "requires": ["match", ["var", "u"], "[a-z][a-z]*"]},
  {"name": "valid_state", "params": [["s", "State"]], "result": ["ok2", "Flag"],
   "requires": ["ne", ["var", "s"], ["const", "State", "done"]]},
]
pipes = [
  {"target": "serve", "filter": "valid_user", "bind": {"u": "msg"}},
  {"target": "serve", "filter": "valid_state", "bind": {"s": "state"}},
]
machine = {"states": ["idle", "busy", "done"], "initial": "idle",
           "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [
             {"from": "idle", "to": "busy", "command": "begin", "cost": 2, "when": None},
             {"from": "busy", "to": "busy", "command": "spin", "cost": 1, "when": None},
             {"from": "busy", "to": "done", "command": "finish", "cost": 1,
              "when": ["eq", ["var", "state"], ["const", "State", "done"]]},
             {"from": "idle", "to": "done", "command": "jump", "cost": 9, "when": None},
           ]}
# harness layout
# req: struct x0 -> ops array x1 -> Op x2 (kind x3 w4, count x4 w2), Op x5 (kind x6, count x7)
#      user: string buffer x8 + 8 chars x9..x16
# state: enum x17 (w4)
# msg: string buffer x18 + 8 chars x19..x26
# out: bool x27
# flag: x28
def payload(ops, user, state, msg, out, flag):
    objects = []
    for index, (kind, count) in enumerate(ops):
        objects.append(cell("x%d" % (3 + index * 3), kind, 4))
        objects.append(cell("x%d" % (4 + index * 3), count, 2))
    for index in range(8):
        objects.append(cell("x%d" % (9 + index), ord(user[index]) if index < len(user) else 0, 1))
    objects.append(cell("x17", state, 4))
    for index in range(8):
        objects.append(cell("x%d" % (19 + index), ord(msg[index]) if index < len(msg) else 0, 1))
    objects.append(cell("x27", out, 1))
    objects.append(cell("x28", flag, 1))
    return {"entry": "serve", "ktest": ktest(objects)}

def cell(name, value, width):
    return (name, int(value).to_bytes(width, "little"))

KINDS = {"read": 0, "write": 1}
STATES = {"idle": 0, "busy": 1, "done": 2}
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes, "entries": ["serve"],
       "machine": machine, "runs": []}
answer = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(answer["plans"][0], indent=1)[:1400])
doc["runs"] = [
  # valid: ops small, user "abc", state done, msg "hi"
  payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "abc", STATES["done"], "hi", 1, 0),
  # same inputs, different result -> DUPLICATE
  payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "abc", STATES["done"], "hi", 0, 0),
  # count too large -> entry predicate false -> FILTERED
  payload([("read", 3000), ("write", 7)], "abc", STATES["done"], "hi", 1, 0),
  # user "ABC" fails the match filter -> flag must be 1
  payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "ABC", STATES["busy"], "hi", 1, 1),
  # state done fails valid_state -> flag 1
  payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "abc", STATES["done"], "hi", 1, 1),
  # desired state unreachable: spin/finish require ... done reachable? from idle: begin(2)+finish(1)
  payload([("read", 3), ("write", 7)], "abc", STATES["idle"], "ok", 1, 0),
]
answer = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(answer["records"], indent=1))
print(json.dumps(answer["corpus"], indent=1))
PYEOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/t_showcase.py
